title: Policy evidence and approval review
source_text:
# Synthetic policy requirements and change record

Clause 1: The approved retention policy remains version 4.1 until an amendment is approved.
Clause 2: Records category R-17 retains records for five years under approved version 4.1.
Clause 3: Any change to a retention duration requires documented legal review before approval.

evidence.text: Draft policy version 4.2 is dated 10 August 2026.
Draft policy version 4.2 changes R-17 retention from five to seven years.
Legal review was requested but no completion record was supplied.
The applicant reports the current approved policy remains version 4.1.
